lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: taa sohaagan jaaneeai gurasabad beechaare ||3||
lines.translation: Then she is known as the happy soul-bride, if she contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਤ ਕੀ ਬਾਂਧੀ ਸਭ ਫਿਰੈ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kirat kee baa(n)dhee sabh phirai dekhahu beechaaree ||
lines.translation: Bound by the actions she has committed, she wanders around - see this and understand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਆ ਆਖੀਐ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: es no kiaa aakheeai kiaa kare vichaaree ||4||
lines.translation: What can we say to her? What can the poor soul-bride do? ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਈ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ਉਠਿ ਚਲੀ ਚਿਤ ਬੰਧਿ ਨ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaee niraasee uth chalee chit ba(n)dh na dheeraa ||
lines.translation: Disappointed and hopeless, she gets up and departs. There is no support or encouragement in her consciousness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੁ ਭਜੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੫॥੬॥੫੦॥
lines.transliteration: har kee charanee laag rahu bhaj saran kabeeraa ||5||6||50||
lines.translation: So remain attached to the Lord's Lotus Feet, and hurry to His Sanctuary, Kabeer! ||5||6||50||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ₂ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee₂ ||
lines.translation: Gauree :

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਕਹਹਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਭਲ ਮੀਠਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jogee kahahi jog bhal meethaa avar na doojaa bhaaee ||
lines.translation: The Yogi says that Yoga is good and sweet, and nothing else is, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੁੰਡਿਤ ਮੁੰਡਿਤ ਏਕੈ ਸਬਦੀ ਏਇ ਕਹਹਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ru(n)dit mu(n)dit ekai sabadee ei kahahi sidh paaee ||1||
lines.translation: Those who shave their heads, and those who amputate their limbs, and those who utter only a single word, all say that they have attained the spiritual perfection of the Siddhas. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ ਅੰਧਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bin bharam bhulaane a(n)dhaa ||
lines.translation: Without the Lord, the blind ones are deluded by doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਉ ਆਪੁ ਛੁਟਕਾਵਨਿ ਤੇ ਬਾਧੇ ਬਹੁ ਫੰਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa pahi jaau aap chhutakaavan te baadhe bahu pha(n)dhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: And those, to whom I go to find release - they themselves are bound by all sorts of chains. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਤੇ ਉਪਜੀ ਤਹੀ ਸਮਾਨੀ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਿਸਰੀ ਤਬ ਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah te upajee tahee samaanee ih bidh bisaree tab hee ||
lines.translation: The soul is re-absorbed into that from which it originated, when one leaves this path of errors.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਗੁਣੀ ਸੂਰ ਹਮ ਦਾਤੇ ਏਹਿ ਕਹਹਿ ਬਡ ਹਮ ਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)dit gunee soor ham daate ehi kahahi bad ham hee ||2||
lines.translation: The scholarly Pandits, the virtuous, the brave and the generous, all assert that they alone are great. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jisahi bujhaae soee boojhai bin boojhe kiu raheeai ||
lines.translation: He alone understands, whom the Lord inspires to understand. Without understanding, what can anyone do?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਚੂਕੈ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਾਣਕੁ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: satigur milai a(n)dheraa chookai in bidh maanak laheeai ||3||
lines.translation: Meeting the True Guru, the darkness is dispelled, and in this way, the jewel is obtained. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਬਾਵੇ ਦਾਹਨੇ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: taj baave daahane bikaaraa har pad driR kar raheeai ||
lines.translation: Give up the evil actions of your left and right hands, and grasp hold of the Feet of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਗੂੰਗੈ ਗੁੜੁ ਖਾਇਆ ਪੂਛੇ ਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ॥੪॥੭॥੫੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahu kabeer goo(n)gai guR khaaiaa poochhe te kiaa kaheeai ||4||7||51||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, the mute has tasted the molasses, but what can he say about it if he is asked? ||4||7||51||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਗਉੜੀ ਪੂਰਬੀ₁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag gauRee poorabee₁ kabeer jee ||
lines.translation: Raag Gauree Poorbee, Kabeer Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਕਛੁ ਅਹਾ ਤਹਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah kachh ahaa tahaa kichh naahee pa(n)ch tat tah naahee ||
lines.translation: Where something existed, now there is nothing. The five elements are no longer there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਸੁਖਮਨ ਬੰਦੇ ਏ ਅਵਗਨ ਕਤ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: iRaa pi(n)gulaa sukhaman ba(n)de e avagan kat jaahee ||1||
lines.translation: The Ida, the Pingala and the Sushmanaa - O human being, how can the breaths through these be counted now? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਗਾ ਤੂਟਾ ਗਗਨੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਇਆ ਤੇਰਾ ਬੋਲਤੁ ਕਹਾ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: taagaa tootaa gagan binas gaiaa teraa bolat kahaa samaaee ||
lines.translation: The string has been broken, and the Sky of the Tenth Gate has been destroyed. Where has your speech gone?

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਸੰਸਾ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕੋ ਨ ਕਹੈ ਸਮਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: eh sa(n)saa mo kau anadin biaapai mo kau ko na kahai samajhaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: This cynicism afflicts me, night and day; who can explain this to me and help me understand? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਬਰਭੰਡੁ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਚਨਹਾਰੁ ਤਹ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah barabha(n)d pi(n)d tah naahee rachanahaar tah naahee ||
lines.translation: Where the world is - the body is not there; the mind is not there either.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋੜਨਹਾਰੋ ਸਦਾ ਅਤੀਤਾ ਇਹ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਸੁ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: joRanahaaro sadaa ateetaa ih kaheeai kis maahee ||2||
lines.translation: The Joiner is forever unattached; now, within whom is the soul said to be contained? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋੜੀ ਜੁੜੈ ਨ ਤੋੜੀ ਤੂਟੈ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: joRee juRai na toRee tootai jab lag hoi binaasee ||
lines.translation: By joining the elements, people cannot join them, and by breaking, they cannot be broken, until the body perishes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਾ ਕੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਕੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੈ ਜਾਸੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kaa ko thaakur kaa ko sevak ko kaahoo kai jaasee ||3||
lines.translation: Of whom is the soul the master, and of whom is it the servant? Where, and to whom does it go? ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੀ ਹੈ ਜਹਾ ਬਸੇ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahu kabeer liv laag rahee hai jahaa base din raatee ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, I have lovingly focused my attention on that place where the Lord dwells, day and night.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਕਾ ਮਰਮੁ ਓਹੀ ਪਰੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਓਹੁ ਤਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੫੨॥
lines.transliteration: uaa kaa maram ohee par jaanai ohu tau sadaa abinaasee ||4||1||52||
lines.translation: Only He Himself truly knows the secrets of His mystery; He is eternal and indestructible. ||4||1||52||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee ||
lines.translation: Gauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਦੁਇ ਕੰਨੀ ਮੁੰਦਾ ਪਰਮਿਤਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਖਿੰਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: surat simrit dui ka(n)nee mu(n)daa paramit baahar khi(n)thaa ||
lines.translation: Let contemplation and intuitive meditation be your two ear-rings, and true wisdom your patched overcoat.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਆਸਣੁ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਕਲਪ ਬਿਬਰਜਿਤ ਪੰਥਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: su(n)n guphaa mahi aasan baisan kalap bibarajit pa(n)thaa ||1||
lines.translation: In the cave of silence, dwell in your Yogic posture; let the subjugation of desire be your spiritual path. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਜਨ ਮੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere raajan mai bairaagee jogee ||
lines.translation: O my King, I am a Yogi, a hermit, a renunciate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਤ ਨ ਸੋਗ ਬਿਓਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: marat na sog biogee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I do not die or suffer pain or separation. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਮਹਿ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਬਟੂਆ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਸਮਾਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kha(n)d brahama(n)d mahi si(n)ngee meraa batooaa sabh jag bhasamaadhaaree ||
lines.translation: The solar systems and galaxies are my horn; the whole world is the bag to carry my ashes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਲੁ ਪਲਟੀਐ ਛੂਟੈ ਹੋਇ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: taaRee laagee tripal palateeai chhootai hoi pasaaree ||2||
lines.translation: Eliminating the three qualities and finding release from this world is my deep meditation. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਪਵਨੁ ਦੁਇ ਤੂੰਬਾ ਕਰੀ ਹੈ ਜੁਗ ਜੁਗ ਸਾਰਦ ਸਾਜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: man pavan dui too(n)baa karee hai jug jug saarad saajee ||
lines.translation: My mind and breath are the two gourds of my fiddle, and the Lord of all the ages is its frame.
